q: How many customers are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

q: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE is_cancelled = 1

q: Which order category has the most orders?
sql: SELECT category FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average order value in SAR, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_value_sar), 2) FROM orders

q: Total order value in SAR per category, highest first.
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(order_value_sar), 2) FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY 2 DESC

q: How many customers came from each acquisition channel?
sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY acquisition_channel

q: What is the average lifetime value (ltv_sar) of Saudi vs Expat customers, rounded to 0 decimals?
sql: SELECT nationality, ROUND(AVG(ltv_sar), 0) FROM customers GROUP BY nationality

q: Which district has the highest total order value?
sql: SELECT c.district FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.district ORDER BY SUM(o.order_value_sar) DESC LIMIT 1

q: On average, how many minutes later than estimated are deliveries, rounded to 1 decimal?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(actual_delivery_min - estimated_delivery_min), 1) FROM orders

q: Which category has the longest average actual delivery time?
sql: SELECT category FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(actual_delivery_min) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many orders were placed on weekends?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN dates d ON d.date_key = o.order_date_key WHERE d.is_weekend = 1

q: How many orders were placed in each quarter of 2025?
sql: SELECT d.quarter, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN dates d ON d.date_key = o.order_date_key WHERE o.order_date_key LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY d.quarter

q: Which competitor platform has the most points of interest listed?
sql: SELECT competitor_platform FROM competitors GROUP BY competitor_platform ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average commission percentage per competitor platform, rounded to 1 decimal?
sql: SELECT competitor_platform, ROUND(AVG(commission_pct), 1) FROM competitors GROUP BY competitor_platform

q: Which competitor POI has the highest gap score? Return its name.
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM competitors ORDER BY gap_score DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many customers in each district, and how many competitor POIs in the same district?
sql: SELECT c.district, c.n, COALESCE(p.m, 0) FROM (SELECT district, COUNT(*) n FROM customers GROUP BY district) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT district, COUNT(*) m FROM competitors GROUP BY district) p ON p.district = c.district

q: Which 3 customers spent the most in total? Return customer_id and total spend.
sql: SELECT customer_id, ROUND(SUM(order_value_sar), 2) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

q: كم عدد العملاء في فئة القيمة العالية (High Value)؟
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_segment = 'High Value'

q: ما متوسط رسوم التوصيل بالريال لكل فئة طلب؟ قرّب إلى منزلتين عشريتين.
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(delivery_fee_sar), 2) FROM orders GROUP BY category

q: ما الحي الذي فيه أكبر عدد من الطلبات من عملاء الفئة العمرية 18-24؟
sql: SELECT c.district FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.age_range = '18-24' GROUP BY c.district ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
